items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: I was telling Benny Green, who I love, a gifted pianist as you know,

ctx.x: And this is from like somebody that thinks that Glenn Miller was the best thing that ever happened since sliced bread. But suddenly she rose to the occasion when you played the piano. She saw something else in the music.

Well I’ve always had an intensity about playing piano. It’s a very special experience to me. Anytime that I sit down, I was telling Benny Green, who I love, a gifted pianist as you know, and I was telling him that every time I sit down with an instrument, I try to negotiate with that instrument. He was asking me how do you handle these different pianos? Some good, some not so good, some bad, thank God we don’t have too many bad ones nowadays. But I told him I says, the only way to overcome that is you have to sit…
